the-boys-of-bellwood-school-or-frank-jor: Frank V. Webster's school story follows Frank Jordan through his terms at Bellwood School, where lessons, sports, and schoolboy rivalries test his character. Like all good school tales, it rewards honesty and pluck while punishing bullies and cheats. Young readers of the 1910s devoured such books, living their own school days a little more heroically through Frank.
the-boy-scout-camera-club-or-the-confess: Ralphson's Boy Scouts form a camera club, and a photograph's confession solves their mystery. Scouting, sleuthing, and early photography combine. A novel blend of hobbies for 1910s boys. Darkrooms, lenses, and scout law combine in this unusual series entry. A guilty secret, caught on film, drives this clever scout tale.
